**Change** (`export/writer.py`)
- Rows are now lists of strings written with `csv.writer(handle, delimiter=";", lineterminator="\n")` and `open(..., newline="")`, so the explicit `\n` stays untranslated and output is still LF-only UTF-8.
- `QUOTE_MINIMAL` behaviour: only fields that actually need it get wrapped, inner quotes doubled.
- `COLUMNS` replaces the pre-joined `HEADER` string; summary file keeps plain line writing since its values can't contain the separator.

**Test** (`tests/test_export.py::test_export_month_quotes_fields_containing_the_separator`)
```python
b'INV-1;2026-10-01;"M\xc3\xbcller; S\xc3\xb6hne ""AG""";100.00;8.10;108.10;CHF\n'
b'INV-2;2026-10-02;Plain Ltd;100.00;19.00;119.00;EUR\n'
```
Byte-exact assertion plus a `csv.reader` round-trip proving the name comes back verbatim and every row stays 7 fields.

**Regression check:** the production fixture output is unchanged — 95 data rows, `CHF 20 10754.55` / `EUR 75 43418.43` / `skipped 25`, no `\r`, no spurious quotes (plain names are not quoted).
